title: Verify startup on the R8-optimized build

rubric.text: Explains that startup depends on the R8-optimized artifact and a passing debug rule does not exercise that artifact even though startup stays in one app
Recommends a focused device smoke test that launches the installed R8-optimized release build and checks that the home screen becomes visible
Keeps the existing debug integration test for its current purpose without moving unrelated coverage into the release test
